title: Launch Status Meeting
summary: Discussed the status of the mobile build, payment integration issues, and launch date adjustment. Decided to delay the launch to the 17th and agreed on next steps.

discussion_points.summary: Speaker B reported that the mobile build is ready, but the payment integration fails on Android about 5% of the time. Speaker C suggested it might be a timeout on the Geetwee site and offered to fix it by Wednesday.

references.speaker: Sarah
references.quote: George Nizor, the mobile build is ready, but the payment integration still fails on Android about 5% of the time.

references.speaker: Omar
references.quote: I think that is a timeout on the Geetwee site. I can dig into the logs and have a fix ready by Wednesday.

discussion_points.summary: Speaker A proposed pushing the launch from the 10th to the 17th to be safe. Speaker B agreed and committed to updating the marketing team and release calendar today.

references.speaker: George Nizor
references.quote: Great, thanks Omar. Then let's agree to push the launch from the 10th to the 17th to be safe.

references.speaker: Sarah
references.quote: Agreed, I will update the marketing team and the release calendar today.

discussion_points.summary: Speaker C asked if the iPad layout was still needed for the launch or if it could wait for the next version. Speaker A indicated they would check with the client and leave the decision open.

references.speaker: Omar
references.quote: One question, do we still need the iPad layout for launch, or can that wait for the next version?

references.speaker: George Nizor
references.quote: Good question. I need to check with the client first, so let's leave that open for now. Sarah, please also send the meeting notes to the client by tomorrow.

discussion_points.summary: Speaker A asked Speaker B to send the meeting notes to the client by tomorrow. Speaker B confirmed they would do so.
